audience.text: Python developers building document-processing workflows, automation pipelines, or LLM-agent tools that require PS/EPS/XPS conversion, rendering, or metadata extraction.

capabilities.text: Reads PS/EPS documents from file or bytes, parses PostScript content using a full interpreter, and extracts DSC/EPS metadata.
capabilities.title: Read and parse PS/EPS documents

capabilities.text: Reads XPS packages from file or bytes, walks fixed pages and print tickets through XpsParser and XpsPackage.
capabilities.title: Read and parse XPS packages

capabilities.text: Creates PS/EPS and XPS documents from scratch using PsDocument.create() and XpsDocument.create(), drawing via PsCanvas or XpsDocumentBuilder.
capabilities.title: Author PS/EPS and XPS documents

capabilities.text: Builds page content with RenderModelBuilder, supporting paths, text, images, and a clip/state stack to produce RenderDocument.
capabilities.title: Programmatic page construction

capabilities.text: Writes PDF 1.4 output using PdfWriter with TrueType/Type1 font embedding resolved through FontResolver and FontCache.
capabilities.title: Write PDF output

capabilities.text: Rasterizes PS/EPS content to PNG, JPEG, BMP, or TIFF using Skia (skia-python) or a pure-Python fallback renderer.
capabilities.title: Rasterize to common image formats

capabilities.text: Exposes conversions (ps_to_pdf, ps_to_image, xps_to_pdf, xps_to_image, eps_metadata) as MCP tools via FastMCP-based servers.
capabilities.title: MCP tool exposure

limitations.text: No PDF import or parsing API is provided; the library only writes PDF, it does not read existing PDF files.
XPS-to-image conversion always requires the Skia backend (skia-python); there is no pure-Python fallback.
Importing aspose.page.pdf.writer or aspose.page.image.raster_renderer before aspose.page.ps raises a circular-import ImportError.
Font embedding requires an explicit additional_fonts_folder path via FontResolver; automatic system-font discovery is not provided.
The MCP server exposes only conversion/metadata tools; document creation APIs (PsDocument.create, XpsDocument.create) are not available as MCP tools.

problems_solved.text: Enables PS/EPS/XPS to PDF conversion and raster output (PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF) without requiring Ghostscript or Adobe tooling.
Provides a programmatic render model to construct page content from scratch and write it directly to PDF or raster formats.
Exposes document conversions as MCP tools for LLM-agent and automation workflows via HTTP.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Page FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for reading, authoring, and converting PostScript, EPS, and XPS documents to PDF or raster formats without external tooling.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports reading JXR, WDP, or other listed input formats beyond PS, EPS, and XPS is not confirmed by examples or public symbols.
The exact behavior of DscMetadata fields beyond bounding_box and title is not demonstrated in examples.
Whether font embedding supports CJK or other complex scripts is not stated in the available facts.
The scope of XpsRenderer capabilities beyond page rendering is not detailed in the facts.
Whether the library supports multi-page XPS documents beyond single-page examples is not explicitly confirmed.
The behavior of ImageSaveOptions.raster_writer when switching between Skia and Python renderers is not demonstrated for XPS.

workflows.name: Convert PS to PDF
workflows.text: Call the ps_to_pdf handler with an McpInput pointing to a .ps file and an McpOutput specifying the output path.

workflows.name: Render EPS to image
workflows.text: Use RasterRenderer with a RenderDocument built from EPS content and encode the result as PNG, JPEG, BMP, or TIFF.

workflows.name: Build PDF from render model
workflows.text: Import aspose.page.ps first, use RenderModelBuilder to construct pages with text and paths, then write to PDF using PdfWriter.

workflows.name: Extract EPS metadata
workflows.text: Invoke eps_metadata with an McpInput to retrieve bounding box, title, and other DSC/EPS metadata fields.

workflows.name: Convert XPS to PDF
workflows.text: Call the xps_to_pdf handler with an McpInput pointing to a .xps file and an McpOutput specifying the output path.

workflows.name: Render page to PNG without input
workflows.text: Create a RenderDocument with RenderPage, render it using RasterRenderer, and encode the surface as PNG.
